'''Stephen Smith''' (also published as '''Steven Smith''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Arizona State Championship]] on 14 April 2001 with troopers, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2082">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Steven Smith he played at [[June 2000 Tempe tournament (11 June)]] on 11 June 2000 with Yavin 4 Trooper Assault, according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d884">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-out-of-hibernationd884/ out-of-hibernation], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 12 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-out-of-hibernationd884/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
